# Why hod declines the corpus

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask corpus reasons --report <this file>`. Do not edit: run the command again. -->

Every module of the captured corpus (`docs/status/corpus.md`), given to hod in strict mode with its `llc` arguments: as bitcode from its LLVM's `llvm-as`, read natively (the default route). The first refusal is the reason the coverage log records; the census (`HOD_CENSUS=1`) is every reason, the list of what to implement next (`spec/cli.md` "Reasons"). A count is of modules.

## The routes agree

Modules whose outcome and first reason are the same by two routes, and whose census is the same set of reasons. The census's order is the order the reasons were met, which follows each reader's numbering of symbols (`hod_ll` numbers a symbol at its first mention, `hod_bc` in record order); the last column counts the modules whose census is in the same order by all three routes.
